resources.string: Shown when opening the app without a file. This choice is saved immediately.
Tap to step one frame. Hold to repeat using the schedule below. This toggle is saved immediately.
Hold-to-repeat is off. You can still edit and save its schedule.
The initial delay is measured from the button press. Stage start times are measured after repeating begins. Edits apply only when you save.
Stage count: 1-%1$d. Start times (seconds): 0-%2$d, increasing from 0. Speed (frames/sec): %3$s-%4$s.
Hold delay (seconds): enter a value from 0 to %1$d.
Add at least one stage that starts at 0 seconds.
Stage count must be between 1 and %1$d.
The first stage must start at 0 seconds.
Start time (seconds): enter a value from 0 to %1$d.
Start after the preceding stage. Stage start times must increase.
Use a speed from %1$s to %2$s frames/sec.
Enter a finite number of seconds for the hold delay.
Enter numeric seconds and frames/sec in both stage fields.
